# GENERATED by tools/build_unity.py - edit the script, not this file.
# The German question: logic behind the API of TOTU_unity_api.txt, the window, the referendum and the 2+4 talks.
# Global variables: TOTU_unity (scale 0..100), TOTU_unity_ddr, TOTU_unity_ger (contributions), TOTU_unity_thaw_day
# (global.num_days on which a freeze of the API ends, 0 = none).
# Global flags: TOTU_unity_initialised, TOTU_unity_frozen (cleared by the thaw event totu_unity.40),
# TOTU_unity_2p4_asked, TOTU_unity_2p4_pending (timed), TOTU_unity_soviet_consent / _veto, TOTU_unity_monetary_union,
# TOTU_unity_referendum_pending, TOTU_unity_winner_ddr / _ger, TOTU_unity_referendum_held, TOTU_germany_unified,
# TOTU_unified_by_ddr / _ger, TOTU_unity_talks_ended.

# 1 January 1990: Kohl's Ten Points are out (28 November 1989), the Wall is open. Run once from on_startup.
TOTU_unity_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_initialised } }
		set_global_flag = TOTU_unity_initialised
		set_variable = { global.TOTU_unity = 10 }
		set_variable = { global.TOTU_unity_ddr = 4 }
		set_variable = { global.TOTU_unity_ger = 6 }
		set_variable = { global.TOTU_unity_thaw_day = 0 }
		TOTU_unity_update = yes
	}
}

# The wrappers set temp variables un_scale, un_ddr, un_ger. While the talks are frozen nothing grows and nobody's
# contribution changes; a setback (un_scale < 0) still applies.
TOTU_unity_apply = {
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_frozen }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { un_scale < 0 } }
				add_to_variable = { global.TOTU_unity = un_scale }
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { global.TOTU_unity = un_scale }
			add_to_variable = { global.TOTU_unity_ddr = un_ddr }
			add_to_variable = { global.TOTU_unity_ger = un_ger }
		}
		TOTU_unity_update = yes
	}
}

# After every change: clamp, check the 2+4 talks and the referendum, then redraw the window of both countries (after
# the check, so that a flag it sets is drawn at once).
TOTU_unity_update = {
	clamp_variable = { var = global.TOTU_unity min = 0 max = 100 }
	TOTU_unity_check = yes
	TOTU_unity_refresh = yes
}

TOTU_unity_refresh = {
	if = { limit = { country_exists = DDR } DDR = { TOTU_unity_set_gfx = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = GER } GER = { TOTU_unity_set_gfx = yes } }
}

# temp un_state: the flags the window draws (1 frozen, 2 Moscow deciding, 4 referendum called, 8 talks ended)
TOTU_unity_state = {
	set_temp_variable = { un_state = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_frozen } add_to_temp_variable = { un_state = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_2p4_pending } add_to_temp_variable = { un_state = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_referendum_pending } add_to_temp_variable = { un_state = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_talks_ended } add_to_temp_variable = { un_state = 8 } }
}

# The freeze wrappers (temp un_freeze_days): frozen until today + un_freeze_days, or later if a longer freeze is on.
# The wrapper schedules totu_unity.40 for its own end; only the event of the last end thaws.
TOTU_unity_freeze = {
	set_temp_variable = { un_thaw = global.num_days }
	add_to_temp_variable = { un_thaw = un_freeze_days }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_frozen }
				check_variable = { un_thaw > global.TOTU_unity_thaw_day }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.TOTU_unity_thaw_day = un_thaw }
	}
	set_global_flag = TOTU_unity_frozen
	TOTU_unity_refresh = yes
}

# totu_unity.40 and the weekly check: end a freeze of the wrappers once its day has come; then the decisions are back,
# the window is redrawn and the referendum is checked.
TOTU_unity_thaw_check = {
	set_temp_variable = { un_now = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_frozen
			check_variable = { global.TOTU_unity_thaw_day > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { un_now < global.TOTU_unity_thaw_day } }
		}
		clr_global_flag = TOTU_unity_frozen
		set_variable = { global.TOTU_unity_thaw_day = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
			TOTU_unity_update = yes
		}
	}
}

# on_weekly_DDR: a safety net for flags that change on their own (a timed flag set directly by someone else, the
# 30-day 2+4 wait): redraw the window and re-check the referendum when the drawn state is out of date.
TOTU_unity_weekly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_frozen } }
		set_variable = { global.TOTU_unity_thaw_day = 0 }
	}
	TOTU_unity_thaw_check = yes
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
		DDR = {
			TOTU_unity_state = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { TOTU_un_shown_state = un_state } } }
				TOTU_unity_update = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

TOTU_unity_check = {
	# the Soviet factor: the first time the scale reaches 75, Moscow is asked (if it is still the GDR's overlord)
	if = {
		limit = {
			TOTU_unity_open = yes
			NOT = { has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_2p4_asked }
			check_variable = { global.TOTU_unity > 74.99 }
		}
		set_global_flag = TOTU_unity_2p4_asked
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = SOV
				DDR = { is_subject_of = SOV }
			}
			set_global_flag = { flag = TOTU_unity_2p4_pending value = 1 days = 30 }
			SOV = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.30 days = 1 } }
		}
	}
	# the referendum: at 100 while the talks run and Moscow is not deciding
	if = {
		limit = {
			TOTU_unity_active = yes
			check_variable = { global.TOTU_unity > 99.99 }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_2p4_pending }
		}
		TOTU_unity_call_referendum = yes
	}
}

# on_monthly_DDR: the street wants unity ("Wir sind ein Volk"): +1 a month, +2 under a democratic GDR government.
TOTU_unity_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_unity_active = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { TOTU_unity_ddr_democratic = yes }
			add_to_variable = { global.TOTU_unity = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { global.TOTU_unity = 1 }
		}
		TOTU_unity_update = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
		TOTU_unity_update = yes
	}
}

# The winner is fixed when the referendum is called (the decisions stop); the vote is held 14 days later. Called only
# from TOTU_unity_check, inside TOTU_unity_update, which redraws the window right after.
TOTU_unity_call_referendum = {
	set_global_flag = TOTU_unity_referendum_pending
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_unity_ddr_leads = yes }
		set_global_flag = TOTU_unity_winner_ddr
	}
	else = {
		set_global_flag = TOTU_unity_winner_ger
	}
	DDR = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.1 } }
	GER = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.1 } }
	GER = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.2 days = 14 } }
}

# Event totu_unity.4 (hidden, the winner, a day after the results).
TOTU_unity_unify = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = DDR
			country_exists = GER
			NOT = { has_global_flag = TOTU_germany_unified }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_winner_ddr }
			TOTU_unity_unify_by_ddr = yes
		}
		else = {
			TOTU_unity_unify_by_ger = yes
		}
	}
}

# The FRG wins: the GDR leaves the Warsaw Pact (if it is still in the bloc) and accedes; the five new Laender become
# FRG cores. Cosmetic tag TOTU_GER_UNIFIED: Germany / the Federal Republic of Germany, the black-red-gold flag.
TOTU_unity_unify_by_ger = {
	set_global_flag = TOTU_germany_unified
	set_global_flag = TOTU_unified_by_ger
	clr_global_flag = TOTU_unity_referendum_pending
	DDR = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_subject = yes
					is_in_faction = yes
				}
			}
			TOTU_bloc_leave = yes
		}
		every_core_state = { add_core_of = GER }
	}
	GER = {
		annex_country = { target = DDR transfer_troops = yes }
		set_cosmetic_tag = TOTU_GER_UNIFIED
		add_timed_idea = { idea = TOTU_unity_growing_together days = 730 }
		news_event = { id = totu_unity.21 hours = 6 }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { is_core_of = DDR }
		remove_core_of = DDR
	}
}

# The GDR wins: the FRG leaves NATO and is absorbed. A communist GDR stays in the Soviet bloc (cosmetic tag: Germany,
# the German Democratic Republic, the GDR flag); a democratic GDR unites a neutral Germany outside both blocs (Germany,
# the black-red-gold flag without the emblem).
TOTU_unity_unify_by_ddr = {
	set_global_flag = TOTU_germany_unified
	set_global_flag = TOTU_unified_by_ddr
	clr_global_flag = TOTU_unity_referendum_pending
	GER = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
			leave_faction = yes
		}
		every_core_state = { add_core_of = DDR }
	}
	DDR = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_government = communism }
				OR = {
					is_subject = yes
					is_in_faction = yes
				}
			}
			TOTU_bloc_leave = yes
		}
		annex_country = { target = GER transfer_troops = yes }
		set_cosmetic_tag = TOTU_DDR_UNIFIED
		add_timed_idea = { idea = TOTU_unity_growing_together days = 730 }
		news_event = { id = totu_unity.22 hours = 6 }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { is_core_of = GER }
		remove_core_of = GER
	}
}

# Scope: DDR or GER (the viewer of the window). Mirrors the globals into the country variables the window reads:
# TOTU_un_scale / _ddr / _ger / _share_ddr / _share_ger (texts), TOTU_un_bar_1..10 and TOTU_un_tug_1..10 (frames 1..6),
# TOTU_un_knot_x / _y (the knot), TOTU_un_shown_state (the flags drawn, see TOTU_unity_state); bumps TOTU_un_dirty.
TOTU_unity_set_gfx = {
	TOTU_unity_state = yes
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_shown_state = un_state }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_scale = global.TOTU_unity }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_ddr = global.TOTU_unity_ddr }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_ger = global.TOTU_unity_ger }
	# scale: filled cells of 2 % = floor(scale / 2)
	set_temp_variable = { ung_q = global.TOTU_unity }
	divide_temp_variable = { ung_q = 2 }
	set_temp_variable = { ung_cells = ung_q }
	round_temp_variable = ung_cells
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { ung_cells > ung_q } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { ung_cells = 1 } }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_1 = ung_cells }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_bar_1 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_2 = ung_cells }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_2 = 5 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_bar_2 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_3 = ung_cells }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_3 = 10 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_bar_3 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_4 = ung_cells }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_4 = 15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_bar_4 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_4 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_5 = ung_cells }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_5 = 20 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_bar_5 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_5 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_6 = ung_cells }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_6 = 25 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_bar_6 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_6 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_7 = ung_cells }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_7 = 30 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_bar_7 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_7 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_8 = ung_cells }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_8 = 35 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_bar_8 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_8 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_9 = ung_cells }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_9 = 40 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_bar_9 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_9 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_10 = ung_cells }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_10 = 45 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_bar_10 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_bar_10 = 1 }
	# share of the GDR in the contributions (50 while nobody has contributed), rounded
	set_temp_variable = { ung_sum = global.TOTU_unity_ddr }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ung_sum = global.TOTU_unity_ger }
	set_temp_variable = { ung_share = 50 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ung_sum > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ung_share = global.TOTU_unity_ddr }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ung_share = 100 }
		divide_temp_variable = { ung_share = ung_sum }
	}
	round_temp_variable = ung_share
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_share_ddr = ung_share }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_share_ger = 100 }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_share_ger = ung_share }
	# tug bar: red cells = round(share / 2)
	set_temp_variable = { ung_tc = ung_share }
	divide_temp_variable = { ung_tc = 2 }
	round_temp_variable = ung_tc
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_1 = ung_tc }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_tug_1 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_2 = ung_tc }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_2 = 5 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_tug_2 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_3 = ung_tc }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_3 = 10 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_tug_3 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_4 = ung_tc }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_4 = 15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_tug_4 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_4 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_5 = ung_tc }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_5 = 20 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_tug_5 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_5 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_6 = ung_tc }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_6 = 25 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_tug_6 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_6 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_7 = ung_tc }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_7 = 30 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_tug_7 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_7 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_8 = ung_tc }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_8 = 35 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_tug_8 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_8 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_9 = ung_tc }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_9 = 40 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_tug_9 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_9 = 1 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_10 = ung_tc }
	subtract_from_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_10 = 45 }
	clamp_variable = { var = TOTU_un_tug_10 min = 0 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_tug_10 = 1 }
	# the knot sits on the border between red and blue: x = 69 + 7 x red cells
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_knot_x = ung_tc }
	multiply_variable = { TOTU_un_knot_x = 7 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_knot_x = 69 }
	set_variable = { TOTU_un_knot_y = 161 }
	add_to_variable = { TOTU_un_dirty = 1 }
}
